versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Work Productivity Gog Google Workflow Helper skill:

- Provides practical support for users seeking Gog-style workflows, especially for bug fixing, setup hardening, reliability improvements, or creating adjacent workflows.
- Offers a clear step-by-step workflow for restating user needs, crafting work plans or templates, requesting only key missing information, and delivering actionable outputs.
- Produces checklists, scripts, templates, or decision aids suitable for on-premise use (CPU/local-hardware friendly).
- Includes validation steps to ensure outputs are actionable and meet success criteria.
- Triggered by keywords and scenarios focused on work-productivity, Google Workspace tools, workflow automation, and similar needs.
